name: hcportal_getKennelProducts
description: One kennel's product catalogue for the portal Products view. Includes inactive items by default, and unlike the app's rowset it returns SourceJson (supplier detail), which is deliberately kept off hashers' phones.

parameters.name: activeOnly
parameters.description: 0 returns everything the kennel has listed, 1 only what is on sale

rowsets.name: Products
rowsets.description: The kennel's catalogue, on-sale items first, then SortOrder, then Name.

columns.name: productType
columns.description: 2 membership, 3 haberdashery, 4 run package, 5 away weekend

columns.name: description
columns.description: Free text shown to the hasher

columns.name: promotionalCredit
columns.description: Credit granted on top of the cash

columns.name: unitCost
columns.description: What it costs the kennel to supply

columns.name: margin
columns.description: priceCharged minus unitCost, computed server-side so every surface agrees

columns.name: runCount
columns.description: Runs a package is worth; NULL otherwise

columns.name: sourceJson
columns.description: Supplier detail. PORTAL ONLY — never in the app sync rowset

columns.name: isActive
columns.description: On sale. Not the same as Removed

columns.name: unitsSold
columns.description: Non-removed payments against this product. Drives the take-off-sale-instead-of-delete warning

rowsets.description: Portal envelope shape (Success, ErrorMessage), returned on bad publicKennelId, auth failure, kennel not found, or a manageProducts denial.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
sourceJson must never be added to an app-facing rowset
